message: Turn 30 fixed at 4107cec945f774babc4d7d15a5c78b8c580c2969, Dispatcher 2.2.8. Changed files: .agent-handoff/dispatcher.py, .agent-handoff/dispatcher-runtime.py, .agent-handoff/test_control_bootstrap.py. Installer unchanged and still version-dynamic. Tests: python3 -m py_compile dispatcher.py dispatcher-runtime.py test_control_bootstrap.py exit 0; python3 test_control_bootstrap.py printed test_control_bootstrap: OK and node inferTurnRole: OK, exit 0. Recovery semantics: /c/WEB:<id> is an accepted live URL, not stale by syntax. stale_url only if navigation was observed and the page did not remain on the saved conversation. Zero messages on that URL wait and do not resend bootstrap; one recovery is allowed after 3 unready checks. An observed navigation away recovers once immediately. recovery_used is copied into the same write that replaces the URL, so a crash cannot drop the latch. Later polls cannot create another service chat or resend bootstrap. Fallback reads article[data-testid^=conversation-turn-] and [data-message-id], and infers role from the author attribute or accessible label, not the turn test id. CONTROL_RETRY_SECONDS, wake de-duplication, and text-free diagnostics are unchanged. main and arena/local-agent-v0 were not modified. Phase 2 and live mailbox were not enabled.
